facts.fact: Adwave advertises a minimum of $30 per day for its TV advertising, letting businesses test TV without committing their full budget.
facts.quote: With [Adwave's $30-a-day minimum](https://adwave.com/pricing/), you can test TV without committing your entire budget.

facts.fact: The page states a rule of thumb that marketing for a new location should be 10-15% of projected first-year revenue, higher than for an established location.
facts.quote: Plan for marketing to be 10-15% of projected first-year revenue for a new location.

facts.fact: The page recommends spending 40-50% of a new location's first-year marketing budget in the first 90 days.
facts.quote: Plan 40-50% of your first-year marketing budget for the first 90 days.

facts.fact: In the page's illustrative budget example, a new location's first-year projected revenue is $500,000.
In the page's illustrative example, a 12% marketing budget on $500,000 first-year revenue is $60,000.
In the page's illustrative example, the first 90 days (45% of the marketing budget) receive $27,000, about $9,000 per month.
The page's suggested pre-opening TV budget for a new location is $500-1,000 for awareness building.
The page's suggested TV budget for opening week for a new location is $1,000-2,000.
The page suggests a TV budget of $500-1,000 per month for the first 90 days of sustained presence after opening.
The page estimates a total TV budget of $3,500-6,000 for the critical first 90 days of a new location launch.
facts.quote: That's $3,500-6,000 for TV in the critical first 90 days

facts.fact: The page's launch timeline starts awareness building 4-6 weeks before a new location opens.
The page's timeline begins grand opening buzz 2 weeks before a new location opens.
The page recommends pre-opening teaser campaigns running 2-4 weeks before the grand opening.
The page says the first 90 days after opening should maintain a consistent TV presence and not go dark after opening.
facts.quote: Consistent TV presence (don't go dark after opening)

facts.fact: AdWave states that its campaigns start at $30 a day.
AdWave's FAQ states that most second business locations take 12-18 months to reach the original location's performance, with no cited source.
facts.quote: Most second locations take 12-18 months to reach the original location's performance.
